contract_metadata.purpose: Define future conversation interpretation and custody targets for Decision Work Briefs without implementing runtime extraction.

custody_policy.deterministic_code_role: Preserve shape, source refs, source status, missingness, redaction/private availability, custody flags, schema validity, and non-claims.
custody_policy.interpretation_role: Messy conversation meaning belongs to bounded LLM interpretation or later human review.

decision_shape.purpose: Name the decision the conversation was working on.
decision_shape.human_review_required_when: decision framing is disputed, high stakes, or source context is thin
decision_shape.empty_meaning: The contract has not identified the decision question.
decision_shape.checked_in_safe_policy: Use paraphrase or structured summary only.
decision_shape.local_private_policy: May inspect local conversation context without exporting raw content.

decision_shape.purpose: Describe the likely pre-pressure direction or default action.
decision_shape.human_review_required_when: vanilla overlap, user intent, or private context is material
decision_shape.empty_meaning: No safe starting-direction read has been made.
decision_shape.checked_in_safe_policy: Allowed only as provisional paraphrase with uncertainty.
decision_shape.local_private_policy: Should compare conversation, original answer, revised answer, and memo when available.

decision_shape.purpose: Describe what the decision-maker would do differently now.
decision_shape.human_review_required_when: action consequence is contested or source depth is weak
decision_shape.checked_in_safe_policy: Allowed as provisional summary with non-claims.
decision_shape.local_private_policy: Should be checked against revised answer and memo before user-facing use.

options_and_paths.purpose: List options that remained live during the decision work.
options_and_paths.human_review_required_when: options imply real-world obligations, safety, legality, or high-stakes tradeoffs
options_and_paths.empty_meaning: No live options have been safely interpreted.
options_and_paths.checked_in_safe_policy: Use only safe paraphrase and status, not raw option text.
options_and_paths.local_private_policy: Read local conversation and revised-answer context before asserting option status.

options_and_paths.purpose: Preserve paths the process appears to have dropped or rejected.
options_and_paths.human_review_required_when: lost value or stakeholder harm may be material
options_and_paths.empty_meaning: No abandoned or rejected option has been identified.
options_and_paths.checked_in_safe_policy: Allowed as provisional summary with lost-value caveat.
options_and_paths.local_private_policy: Should compare original, conversation, revised answer, and memo.

options_and_paths.purpose: Mark whether an option is live, rejected, deferred, missing, or unclear.
options_and_paths.human_review_required_when: status would affect a serious action or stakeholder duty
options_and_paths.empty_meaning: Option status has not been determined.
options_and_paths.checked_in_safe_policy: Status labels must remain provisional and source-bound.
options_and_paths.local_private_policy: Use local context to avoid inventing abandoned paths.

options_and_paths.purpose: Capture thresholds that must be met before action.
options_and_paths.human_review_required_when: thresholds affect legal, safety, employment, or customer commitments
options_and_paths.empty_meaning: No decision threshold has been captured.
options_and_paths.checked_in_safe_policy: Summarize thresholds without raw private passages.
options_and_paths.local_private_policy: Verify threshold meaning against local context when possible.

options_and_paths.purpose: Capture conditions that stop, pause, or reverse action.
options_and_paths.human_review_required_when: stop rules affect safety, compliance, employment, or irreversible action
options_and_paths.checked_in_safe_policy: Summarize only with source status and uncertainty.
options_and_paths.local_private_policy: Check against revised answer and memo before relying on it.

options_and_paths.purpose: Capture what evidence would make the decision more or less supportable.
options_and_paths.human_review_required_when: evidence requirements are domain-specific or safety-critical
options_and_paths.checked_in_safe_policy: Keep as provisional decision condition, not proof.
options_and_paths.local_private_policy: Verify against local artifacts before customer-facing use.

conversation_process.purpose: Record process-shape depth without inferring quality.
conversation_process.human_review_required_when: turn boundaries are malformed or capture is disputed
conversation_process.checked_in_safe_policy: Counts and capture status may be checked in.
conversation_process.local_private_policy: Do not export raw transcript text.

conversation_process.purpose: Preserve whether the assistant appears to have shaped the user's decision frame.
conversation_process.human_review_required_when: influence would change product claims or user trust
conversation_process.checked_in_safe_policy: Only safe summary with uncertainty may be exported.
conversation_process.local_private_policy: Requires local conversation review before stronger claims.

conversation_process.purpose: Record whether the user's stance appears to change during the exchange.
conversation_process.human_review_required_when: the field could be read as product value or persuasion evidence
conversation_process.empty_meaning: No user stance-change read is available.
conversation_process.checked_in_safe_policy: Do not imply persuasion or value without review.

conversation_process.purpose: Preserve possible over-agreement or accommodation risk.
conversation_process.human_review_required_when: the read affects trust in the process or user-facing claims
conversation_process.empty_meaning: No sycophancy or over-accommodation read is available.
conversation_process.checked_in_safe_policy: Use as provisional risk, not verdict.

conversation_process.purpose: Capture threads that remain unresolved after the answer.
conversation_process.human_review_required_when: unresolved thread is high-stakes or domain-specific
conversation_process.local_private_policy: Verify private nuance before user-facing claim.

conversation_process.purpose: Capture threads present in the conversation but not carried forward.
conversation_process.human_review_required_when: dropped thread could represent lost value or stakeholder harm
conversation_process.checked_in_safe_policy: Use summary only; avoid raw passages.
conversation_process.local_private_policy: Verify against local conversation when possible.

conversation_process.purpose: Record whether the process pressured assumptions with premortem or counterfactual frames.
conversation_process.human_review_required_when: the pressure is used to claim decision usefulness
conversation_process.empty_meaning: No premortem or counterfactual pressure is recorded.
conversation_process.checked_in_safe_policy: Record presence and summary, not effectiveness.
conversation_process.local_private_policy: Local review may clarify pressure content without exporting raw text.

conversation_process.purpose: Capture alternative ways the decision was framed.
conversation_process.human_review_required_when: frame choice changes a serious action or stakeholder obligation
conversation_process.empty_meaning: No alternative frame read is available.
conversation_process.checked_in_safe_policy: Use provisional summary with source status.
conversation_process.local_private_policy: Verify against local context before stronger claims.

provided_context_and_evidence.purpose: Record what context came from the user rather than the assistant.
provided_context_and_evidence.human_review_required_when: context ownership is material to trust or action
provided_context_and_evidence.checked_in_safe_policy: Only metadata or safe paraphrase may be exported.
provided_context_and_evidence.local_private_policy: May inspect local conversation without copying raw content.

provided_context_and_evidence.purpose: Record whether pasted or external context shaped the decision.
provided_context_and_evidence.human_review_required_when: documents contain private, legal, safety, or customer data
provided_context_and_evidence.empty_meaning: No pasted or external context is recorded.
provided_context_and_evidence.checked_in_safe_policy: Record presence/status only unless summary is explicitly safe.
provided_context_and_evidence.local_private_policy: Do not export raw document content.

stakeholders_and_values.purpose: Preserve user priorities without deterministically assigning values.
stakeholders_and_values.checked_in_safe_policy: Only provisional summary may be exported.
stakeholders_and_values.local_private_policy: Requires local-private review and preferably human correction.

stakeholders_and_values.human_review_required_when: always when stakeholder duties affect action
stakeholders_and_values.local_private_policy: Review with local context before brief publication.

stakeholders_and_values.purpose: Preserve relationship, power, or political constraints affecting the decision.
stakeholders_and_values.empty_meaning: No relationship or political constraint is recorded.
stakeholders_and_values.checked_in_safe_policy: Export only safe summary if explicitly reviewed.
stakeholders_and_values.local_private_policy: Inspect local context without copying raw content.

constraints_and_unknowns.purpose: Preserve timing pressure and runway constraints.
constraints_and_unknowns.human_review_required_when: timing changes risk tolerance or irreversible action
constraints_and_unknowns.empty_meaning: No timing or runway constraint is recorded.
constraints_and_unknowns.checked_in_safe_policy: Use summary with uncertainty and source status.
constraints_and_unknowns.local_private_policy: Verify against local context when material.

constraints_and_unknowns.purpose: Preserve capacity constraints that decide whether action is operable.
constraints_and_unknowns.human_review_required_when: capacity constraints are domain-specific or safety-critical
constraints_and_unknowns.empty_meaning: No operational capacity constraint is recorded.
constraints_and_unknowns.checked_in_safe_policy: Use summary and missingness, not certification.
constraints_and_unknowns.local_private_policy: Local review should verify real-world context.

constraints_and_unknowns.purpose: Preserve legal, compliance, or safety constraints as human-review-sensitive.
constraints_and_unknowns.human_review_required_when: always when the field affects action
constraints_and_unknowns.empty_meaning: No legal, compliance, or safety constraint is recorded.
constraints_and_unknowns.checked_in_safe_policy: Only safe summary and human-review requirement may be exported.
constraints_and_unknowns.local_private_policy: Requires local review; do not export raw sensitive content.

constraints_and_unknowns.purpose: Name facts outside the model/conversation that remain unknown.
constraints_and_unknowns.checked_in_safe_policy: Allowed as missingness, not negative evidence.
constraints_and_unknowns.local_private_policy: Local review may clarify whether unknowns were actually supplied.

constraints_and_unknowns.purpose: Preserve explicit humility about context not available to the model.
constraints_and_unknowns.empty_meaning: No additional unknown-unknown caveat is recorded.
constraints_and_unknowns.checked_in_safe_policy: May be rendered as a non-claim.
constraints_and_unknowns.local_private_policy: Use local context to avoid overstating absence.

audit_pressure_and_change.purpose: Summarize the assumptions, frames, gates, or tradeoffs pressured by the audit.
audit_pressure_and_change.human_review_required_when: pressure read is customer-facing or high-stakes
audit_pressure_and_change.checked_in_safe_policy: Use provisional summary with source refs and non-claims.
audit_pressure_and_change.local_private_policy: Compare audit artifacts with conversation/revised context.

audit_pressure_and_change.purpose: Summarize action, threshold, sequence, gate, stop rule, or scope changes.
audit_pressure_and_change.human_review_required_when: change read implies product value or action authority
audit_pressure_and_change.local_private_policy: Should compare original conversation, revised answer, and memo.

losses_and_overcorrection.purpose: Identify pressure that appears decision-useful without scoring it.
losses_and_overcorrection.human_review_required_when: used as product evidence or customer-facing claim
losses_and_overcorrection.local_private_policy: Compare against local context and possible lost value.

losses_and_overcorrection.purpose: Identify pressure that may be process drag or generic caution.
losses_and_overcorrection.human_review_required_when: field changes product or user-facing conclusion
losses_and_overcorrection.local_private_policy: Use local context to avoid dismissing useful caution.

losses_and_overcorrection.purpose: Preserve value that may have been lost when the answer changed.
losses_and_overcorrection.human_review_required_when: always before product evidence or customer-facing claims
losses_and_overcorrection.checked_in_safe_policy: Allowed only as possible lost value with uncertainty.
losses_and_overcorrection.local_private_policy: Requires local context and preferably human correction.

losses_and_overcorrection.purpose: Preserve risk that the revised path became too narrow, cautious, or operationally heavy.
losses_and_overcorrection.human_review_required_when: overcorrection may affect action or stakeholder harm
losses_and_overcorrection.local_private_policy: Check against local context before stronger claims.

losses_and_overcorrection.purpose: Preserve risk that the brief sounds more certain than sources allow.
losses_and_overcorrection.human_review_required_when: brief may be shown beyond internal review
losses_and_overcorrection.checked_in_safe_policy: May be rendered as source-limit warning.
losses_and_overcorrection.local_private_policy: Use local checks to decide whether risk is reduced.

losses_and_overcorrection.purpose: Preserve risk that the process produced generic caution rather than decision-useful change.
losses_and_overcorrection.human_review_required_when: risk is used to decide product usefulness

losses_and_overcorrection.purpose: Preserve risk that the revised path lost useful ambition or speed.
losses_and_overcorrection.human_review_required_when: always before strong product or user-facing claims
losses_and_overcorrection.empty_meaning: No momentum or ambition-loss read is available.
losses_and_overcorrection.checked_in_safe_policy: Use as possible lost value only.
losses_and_overcorrection.local_private_policy: Requires local context and human correction when material.

evidence_and_custody.purpose: Preserve artifact and field references for every interpreted claim.
evidence_and_custody.human_review_required_when: source refs are missing, malformed, or disputed
evidence_and_custody.checked_in_safe_policy: Safe source refs may be checked in if they avoid local paths.
evidence_and_custody.local_private_policy: Use relative run refs or opaque refs, not local absolute paths.

evidence_and_custody.purpose: Record that richer local-private context exists without exporting it.
evidence_and_custody.local_private_policy: May inspect presence and structured metadata read-only.

evidence_and_custody.checked_in_safe_policy: Safe to check in as status only.
evidence_and_custody.local_private_policy: Do not copy redacted source content.

handoff_for_brief.purpose: Keep the brief's non-claims visible to users.
handoff_for_brief.human_review_required_when: non-claims are being narrowed for a customer audience
handoff_for_brief.checked_in_safe_policy: Must remain explicit in checked-in examples.
handoff_for_brief.local_private_policy: Private context may add limits but not remove non-claims.

handoff_for_brief.purpose: Record whether a summary is safe for a user-facing surface without claiming correctness.
handoff_for_brief.empty_meaning: No user-facing safety determination is available.
handoff_for_brief.checked_in_safe_policy: Do not assert true from deterministic code alone.
handoff_for_brief.local_private_policy: Use local context and human review before setting true.

handoff_for_agent_inspection.purpose: Record that an artifact may inform inspection without authorizing action.
handoff_for_agent_inspection.human_review_required_when: agent inspection could be confused with action authorization
handoff_for_agent_inspection.empty_meaning: No agent-inspection handoff status is available.
handoff_for_agent_inspection.checked_in_safe_policy: May be false or provisional; must not authorize action.
handoff_for_agent_inspection.local_private_policy: Do not expose raw private context to agents unless future policy allows it.

handoff_for_agent_inspection.purpose: Mark fields that need human review before stronger use.
handoff_for_agent_inspection.human_review_required_when: field is present and marked true
handoff_for_agent_inspection.checked_in_safe_policy: Safe to check in as status.
handoff_for_agent_inspection.local_private_policy: Human review may inspect private context without exporting it.

handoff_for_agent_inspection.purpose: Mark fields deterministic code must not fill semantically.
handoff_for_agent_inspection.human_review_required_when: LLM interpretation is insufficient or contested
handoff_for_agent_inspection.checked_in_safe_policy: Safe to check in as status.
handoff_for_agent_inspection.local_private_policy: Local-private packets may prepare context for future interpretation.

handoff_for_agent_inspection.purpose: Mark fields owned only by deterministic custody.
handoff_for_agent_inspection.human_review_required_when: metadata conflicts or source status is unclear
handoff_for_agent_inspection.empty_meaning: No deterministic-only metadata status is recorded.
handoff_for_agent_inspection.checked_in_safe_policy: Safe to check in when privacy scan is clean.

handoff_for_agent_inspection.purpose: Mark content or fields that must remain local/private.
handoff_for_agent_inspection.checked_in_safe_policy: Safe to check in only as a status flag.
handoff_for_agent_inspection.local_private_policy: Do not export raw private content.

future_use_notes.next_likely_slice: Design packet or review work against this contract before any runtime extraction plan.
